content.title: APP of As
content.text: Sport anywhere, anytime Stay across all the latest breaking news, insights, videos and images from the world of sports and beyond. Download the AS app now Videos and photos Enjoy our selection of videos - from sports highlights, press conferences and viral footage - from across the globe straight to your device. Current affairs Stay up to date with news, videos, and photos of the most relevant information from national and international affairs. Additionally, enjoy real-time live feeds on major games and events with our expert journalists providing you with insight and entertainment in equal measure. Results service Get live sports information as it happens: results, standings, calendar and matchday info for soccer, NFL, NBA, MLB, tennis, F1, boxing, golf and a whole lot more.
